# Verified selected-image HWPX edit path

This successor corrects only Q1, Q5 and Q10 of delivered Daechi v2. Q1 retains the original two dots without added angle arcs. Q5 puts A below line l, clear of the right-angle mark. Q10 paints a 25%-opacity sector beneath the triangle/spokes, so BO remains fully visible. The revised artifact is `C:/Users/packr/Downloads/대치중_2026_2학년_2학기_중간고사_개선_v3.hwpx`; its native PDF is beside it. The v2 delivery and all earlier evidence remain intact.

## Route selection

Choose `selected-image-payload-patch` when a request changes only a figure's internal marks, labels, fill or drawing order; its embedding dimensions, crop, positioning, question content and ownership remain valid. Edit the selected SVG scene, rasterize only those figure IDs, then replace their bound embedded PNG members. Do not reauthor the document, recreate native equations, rebuild question tables or regenerate unchanged scenes.

Use a local layout revision instead when the image must change aspect ratio or embedding size, becomes clipped by an existing crop, moves to another owner, or shares a binary resource with unrelated uses. This patch tool rejects changed pixel dimensions and shared media. A file extension or filename alone is not an image-to-question binding.

For a previously qualified unchanged package route, the minimal necessary context is the user delta, affected scene source, exact input package hash, question/table/picture/media binding, replacement hash/dimensions and relevant prior check. Whole-paper OCR, all-page source review, a fresh pipeline interview and repeated equation research are unnecessary for this type of change.

## Actual implementation and scope proof

The entrypoint is `bun patch-images.ts /absolute/path/to/patch-job.json`. It invokes a finite stdlib ZIP/XML adapter, not a second agent runtime.

The adapter resolves a unique question table, checks the question number and picture control ID, follows `binaryItemIDRef` through the package manifest, rejects shared media, checks the old payload and new PNG SHA256, and requires identical pixel dimensions. It writes a new versioned HWPX while preserving every other member's uncompressed bytes and entry order.

The actual changed members are:

| Question | Picture control | Media member |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1702942990 | BinData/BIN0001.png |
| 5 | 1307070064 | BinData/BIN0004.png |
| 10 | 1675501133 | BinData/BIN0009.png |

All 29 other package members, including section/header/layout XML, equation scripts, native table/control IDs, picture transforms, previews and the other 18 embedded images, are byte-identical. The existing package preview member is intentionally retained; the refreshed native PDF and `native-three-images.png` are the current visual evidence. This package's preview member is not used as evidence of the new images. A future platform requiring a refreshed embedded thumbnail should treat that as a separately declared derived-member edit.

Native Hancom opened the patched HWPX and exported six pages. All extracted body/math text spans and their native PDF positions match v2 exactly. The three native image crops were visually checked. There is no reason to repeat the earlier Q18 nested-copy probe when its XML, equations and picture are unchanged.

## Types and topology to retain

- `AngleMarker`: distinguish dots, arcs, right-angle corners and equality ticks. Multiple possible encodings do not authorize adding redundant marks absent from the source.
- `LabelPlacement`: bind label A to vertex A while keeping its presentation box clear of the angle mark, edge and baseline. A label move must not change vertex coordinates or incidence.
- `SectorFill`: bind the sector to vertex B and rays BA/BC. Store fill opacity separately from stroke opacity and diagram/image opacity. Draw fill before geometry; preserve BO over the fill.
- `ImageBinding`: question ID -> native table ID -> picture control ID -> binary resource ID -> package member -> old payload hash. Shared media must be explicit.
- `ImageEditScope`: preserve pixel canvas, embedding size/crop/transform and text/layout. Changes outside this envelope require their own invalidation path.
- `VerificationReuse`: exact untouched member identities justify retaining qualified upstream text/equation/table evidence. They do not independently certify previously uncertain source interpretation.

The dependency route is `feedback -> selected source feature -> selected SVG -> selected PNG -> selected BinData member -> affected page image check`. Package equality checks are cheap document-wide checks. Native text-position equality is a bounded layout regression check. Other content recognition and semantic checks are retained with their original qualification limits.

## Cost and time evidence

`patch.actual.json` records 95.784 ms for this actual package replacement plus exact member verification. Native open/export took 12406.263 ms by its receipt. This is a successful occurrence, not a paired comparison against full reauthoring. Selected raster time and agent token usage were not separately measured. Native subscription USD remains unknown. No external paid model/Jev call occurred.

Avoiding unrelated recognition, code generation and validation is the mechanism expected to reduce agent tokens and total time. No numerical token saving or end-to-end percentage improvement has been established. Retain total request-to-completion overhead, including tool discovery and handoff, separately from the sub-100-ms patch stage.

## Integration into the agent knowledge space

Add this as a verified image-only edit capability and recipe, linked to HWPX package/media structure, source-feature types and the existing native-render adapter. Keep routing eligibility, stop/fallback conditions, actual evidence pins and proposed efficiency benefits separate. The task's small manifest and receipt are candidate domain evidence; they do not replace the shared Ontology 0.2.0 or existing source-owned common contracts.

A retrieval case can ask how to fix Q1 dots, Q5 label collision or Q10 fill layering without reauthoring text/math/layout. A useful answer routes to the selected-image patch, includes binding/dimension/shared-media guards, and requests only affected visual evidence plus byte-preservation readback. An incorrect route regenerates the whole HWPX or claims savings from unmeasured tokens. Use the current owner's existing retrieval comparison plan if such a case is admitted; do not create a second evaluation system.
